episode_title: The Power of Mentorship: Building Businesses Together

real_qa.q: How does MB Mentors financially sustain its free mentoring services without employee payroll?
real_qa.r: MB Mentors generates revenue exclusively through paid CEO roundtables for second-stage businesses with revenues between $1 million and $50 million. With 8 to 12 CEOs meeting monthly for 10 months per year, this revenue stream covers organizational costs while all other services—mentoring, webinars, business plan support, women's collective lab, and website resources—remain completely free. Since all 41 volunteer mentors work without compensation, the organization avoids payroll and benefits costs.
real_qa.requete: MB Mentors free mentoring funding model

real_qa.q: What was MB Mentors' business model pivot when the COVID-19 pandemic hit on March 11th, 2020?
real_qa.r: MB Mentors launched on March 6th, 2020, intending to conduct in-person mentoring, workshops, and CEO roundtables, but five days later the pandemic forced an immediate pivot to a virtual organization. The organization quickly adopted Zoom and has since found virtual delivery beneficial for accessibility, though roundtable participants have expressed strong preference for in-person dynamics when possible.
real_qa.requete: MB Mentors COVID-19 pandemic March 2020 pivot

real_qa.q: What is the primary objection early-stage business owners face when engaging with MB Mentors mentorship?
real_qa.r: Early-stage business owners typically discover that starting and running a business costs more money, takes more time, and creates more frustration than expected. The core issue is often not a specific skill gap in marketing, sales, or operations, but rather prioritization—they have so many competing priorities that they cannot execute effectively without help identifying which tasks are urgent and important versus nice to do.
real_qa.requete: early-stage business owner mentorship objections priorities

real_qa.q: How many CEO roundtables does MB Mentors currently operate and what revenue range do they target?
real_qa.r: MB Mentors currently operates six CEO roundtables with 55 total CEOs, targeting second-stage businesses with revenues between $1 million and $50 million and more than 10 full-time employees. The organization is launching an additional new roundtable in Anoka and Sherburne Counties.
real_qa.requete: MB Mentors CEO roundtables revenue $1 million $50 million

real_qa.q: What Hennepin County program did MB Mentors win a contract to facilitate starting in 2020?
real_qa.r: MB Mentors responded to an RFP for Hennepin County for the CEO Next program and became the facilitators of their roundtables. The organization held a four-year contract to provide this service, which supplied significant income during that period while allowing MB Mentors to continue building its own independent roundtables.
real_qa.requete: Hennepin County CEO Next program RFP MB Mentors

guest.bio_context: Art Shore founded MB Mentors almost seven years ago with a group of self-funded co-founders who met at another mentoring organization. He initially wanted to be a teacher, worked in corporate sales and marketing, became an independent consultant, and retired early before getting bored and joining community colleges (Normandale Century and MCTC) to teach part-time, where he began mentoring business founders.
